item.name: Recurring Donations

body.raw:
{
  "organizationId": "{{organizationId}}",
  "causeId": "{{causeId}}",
  "amount": 2.00,
  "frequency": "daily", 
  "specialMessage": "Weekly support for this amazing cause!",
  "paymentMethodId": "{{paymentMethodId}}"
}

/**
 * Helper function to calculate the next donation date based on the user's selected frequency.
 *
 * Used for recurring donations to determine when the next automatic charge should occur.
 *
 * @param {Date} currentDate - The date of the most recent donation.
 * @param {string} frequency - The recurrence interval for the donation.
 *        Supported values: "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", "custom".
 * @param {{ value: number; unit: 'days' | 'weeks' | 'months' }} [customInterval] - 
 *        Required only when frequency is set to "custom". Defines how many units to add.
 *
 * @returns {Date} - The calculated next donation date.
 *
 * @throws {AppError} - Throws an error if an invalid frequency is provided or 
 *                      if "custom" frequency is selected without a valid interval.
 *
 * @example
 * // Monthly recurring donation
 * calculateNextDonationDate(new Date('2025-11-12'), 'monthly');
 * // → Returns Dec 12, 2025
 *
 * @example
 * // Custom recurring donation (every 10 days)
 * calculateNextDonationDate(new Date('2025-11-12'), 'custom', { value: 10, unit: 'days' });
 * // → Returns Nov 22, 2025
 */
